主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) reported a 20% decrease in net earnings to $4,865,000 for the three months ended March 31, 2013, compared to $6,045,000 for the same period in 2012. Diluted net earnings per share also declined by 20% to $0.40, down from $0.50 in the prior-year period. Despite the decline in net earnings, revenue increased by 3% to $17,688,000 for the quarter ended March 31, 2013, compared to $17,182,000 for the same period in 2012.
